reviews.text:
We sought help from Patas & Co because it was our first experience with a dog, and because Lola, being a Border Collie, had some needs and behaviors that we didn't always know how to interpret or manage in the best way.

That's when Pedro came into our lives and, from the very first moment, helped us understand Lola better and find the best ways to deal with the challenges of everyday life. What we value most is the fact that the support isn't limited to individual or group classes. Pedro is always available to listen to us, clarify doubts, and guide us, demonstrating a care and dedication that makes all the difference.

We also can't fail to mention the walking groups that Pedro suggested, which have become one of the best experiences for Lola! It's incredible to see her so happy, playing, socializing, and enjoying every moment with her four-legged friends.

Today we feel we have many more tools and confidence to understand and train Lola. We know we still have a long way to go, but it's very comforting to know that we can continue to count on Pedro along this journey.

We wholeheartedly recommend Patas & Co to anyone looking not only to train their dog, but also to understand them better and build a more balanced and happy relationship with them. 🐾❤️
Awesome!

A huge thank you to this entire team who helped us navigate an important phase between a baby and an anxious dog. We couldn't be happier with the results: baby and dog are friends, and the dog is much calmer.

We had a very positive experience with the school and the trainer. Vicky was our first dog, so from the beginning, we felt there was a lot to learn and understand about her behavior. Mafalda accompanied her with great dedication and professionalism, giving us tools that really made a difference in our daily lives.
Today we feel much safer and calmer on walks on a leash and we can better manage her reactivity in general. It was very important to learn how we should act in different situations.

We still have some aspects to continue working on at home, namely the arrival of people and the reaction to outside noises, but we feel we are on the right track and much more confident to continue training.

We definitely recommend the school to anyone looking for close, personalized support with real results. Thank you for all the help and for giving us back peace of mind on walks with our Vicky! 🐾❤️

I found Patas&Co when I adopted Ferrero, a 6-year-old Labrador who had reactivity issues with other dogs. After having a terrible experience at another school, I joined Patas&Co feeling very unmotivated, frustrated, and distrustful, but thankfully I found all the support, seriousness, and practically 24/7 follow-up. Honestly, the price we paid doesn't compensate for the support I felt! What surprised me most was the dedication and the way they treat us, the owners, to help us help our dogs. Ferrero was a reactive, insecure, and fearful dog; today he is a happy, more confident, fun-loving dog who is great with other dogs!
Patas&Co helped me learn to communicate with my dog, understand him, and respect him.
After the training sessions with Ferrero, I liked their work so much that I wanted to learn more and enrolled in the canine education course. A super complete course, with practical and theoretical components, that prepares us for the job market. I finished the course and, with the help and guidance of all the trainers, I'm now starting to work in the field!
Patas&Co changed our lives for the better, thank you all!
10 stars if they existed! Always the best!

We picked up Trufa from a municipal kennel without really knowing what to expect. We had had family dogs in the past, but we knew that this time we wanted to do things differently and have professional support from the start.

We started at Patas&Co with Trufa's 3-month Puppy pack and we couldn't be happier! We received incredible support in everything: behavioral issues, feeding, and adapting to the house. Above all, they gave us essential tools to deal with each stage of her growth, creating a very strong foundation to overcome the challenges of adolescence (and what's still to come!).

We can't imagine going through this journey without Gabriela, Pedro, and the whole team. More than just training for Trufa, it was a time of enormous learning and deconstructing taboos for us.

Thank you for everything!

We met Patas & Co. when Waffle was about 5 and a half months old. There weren't any serious problems — we simply wanted to make sure we were doing the best we could.
From the beginning, we felt close and professional support, aligned with what we believe in for dog training: respect for the dog's nature, understanding of behavior, and a positive approach.
Waffle grew up balanced and more confident. The normal little puppy difficulties were worked on with guidance and consistency. What we value most is that this support isn't just about training the dog — it's also about teaching us, the owners, to communicate better with him. There are things we do differently today precisely because of that.
In addition to the classes, we have enjoyed nature walks and baths, and the whole team inspires a lot of confidence. The fact that we continue to invest in this support says it all.
We recommend Patas & Co. to any owner who wants to build a more conscious and happy relationship with their dog.
A school with a high level of technical and non-technical skills (care and understanding - for our four-legged friends and their owners too)!

A simple thank you to the whole team, but especially to Mafalda, isn't enough.

I sought out Patas&Co to work on my insecurity and anxiety that had been building up while walking my dog ​​– who is reactive.

It has been a wonderful journey, full of daily challenges – for me and for Rio – but the constant support, the way they explain things to us, the more positive approach to dog training, the patience they have with us, and the affection and care they show, give us a sense of security, strength, and hope that we will succeed. (And we will!!)
Many congratulations on this project and your dedication. 💚
To anyone having difficulties with their furry friends, I recommend this team 100000%. 😊
Thank you, Ana. :)
Best pet grooming and bathing services in Lisbon and Algés. Highly recommended.

We only have positive things to say about Patas & Co! We sought out the school when we felt the need to correct our dog's reactivity, and from the beginning we felt that the trainers were genuinely concerned about helping us. The support is excellent (both in and out of class), the attention they give us and the knowledge they share are fundamental to our success. The group classes are very well organized, and there's always time to give attention to each dog and their needs. The training school service is fantastic; Joca was always very well taken care of, and throughout the day we received videos that showed us just that. The videos are the result of all this: a more balanced and confident dog, both in himself and in us. We will always be grateful to Pedro, Mafalda, and Inês for their help and the care they gave Joca!
Excellent service with dedication and admirable care.
Thank you, Carlotta :)

As a first-time dog owner, I needed a lot of support to understand my puppy’s behavior and how to make sure she’s happy and well-trained. Ines was incredibly helpful and patient throughout the process. I also tried the puppy grooming service and was really pleased with how they treated my little one—the groomer was gentle, and my puppy came back with soft, great-smelling fur. Highly recommend!
Skye and I loved the classes with Mafalda Carvalho from Patas & Co, I highly recommend them! 🫶🏼 …

Excellent professionals. I attended a weekend workshop where I refreshed my knowledge and there was also an opportunity to share experiences with the group. We are always learning. A workshop taught in accessible language, which can help any pet owner better understand their dog's needs. We look forward to more initiatives like this. 💙 Thank you and see you soon.

We decided to start Noah's classes because we were having difficulty managing her interaction and reaction to people and dogs. She reacted out of fear, and it was very difficult to contain/predict these reactions, much less prevent them. Then we met Mafalda, and over time, we, her guardians, learned to communicate with Noah and to read her signals, so that she would become a more self-confident dog. Nowadays, Noah has more self-confidence, and we in her, and she goes for walks in the street without pulling on the leash, doesn't react to people, and can play outside! (which before was a space that caused a lot of anxiety and fear). The group classes allowed her to interact with other owners' dogs in a controlled environment, where we were able to train Noah's impulses in a more challenging setting! Thanks to this, we have gradually been able to have positive interactions with other dogs, both in classes and on daily walks, and in other less positive interactions, Noah quickly calms down and resumes the walk, things that didn't happen before! Thank you to Mafalda and congratulations on your work, availability, kindness, and above all, understanding and sensitivity to reactive cases like Noah's 💖 We will continue the work done so far, and we'll see you in group classes!
An amazing nail trim, my dog ​​came back with the paws of a 2-year-old (he's 8) and loves the groomer! Very qualified and friendly staff, I recommend them!

Inês is spectacular! Even though Caju doesn't like being brushed, he adores Inês! He's always so happy when he goes to Patas&co. Initially, we tried other groomers, but none compared to Inês. There's no one with the same level of affection, dedication, patience, and expertise. We love her and recommend her 100% <3
Thank you, Laura! :)
Thank you, Leonor! :)

My dog ​​is a poodle whose coat requires a lot of care. I don't trust his grooming to anyone else. He's very anxious, but Inês manages to calm him down and make the process as stress-free as possible. It's been a long road, and I couldn't have done it without Patas.
Kale's licks

I started following Patas & Co on social media and sent them some questions via private message, with doubts about the best way to manage certain reactions in my dog. I was always very well received. Inês answered my questions with great attention and professionalism. Later, I sought their grooming service and the experience has been excellent. My dog ​​has challenging behavior during grooming – she cries the whole time, and it's very difficult to perform this service. Inês has immense patience and respects Lucky's rhythm, taking breaks so she can rest and relax a little, which is difficult. The attention and care they have always given us led me to go further, and now I'm starting training with Inês. It has been great to be able to count on the Inêses ☺️. If you are looking for attentive and dedicated professionals who truly care about the well-being of animals and their families, be sure to contact Patas & Co.

Inês is simply AMAZING! Gaspar hates being brushed, so at home we have a lot of difficulty keeping his fur tangle-free. He plays a lot and tangles easily. After several experiences in other places where he practically had to be shaved and left feeling very depressed, Inês was the first professional we found with the patience, expertise, care, and dedication to always save as much of our dog's fur as possible. He always leaves Patas & Co feeling perfectly happy. We love her and I will ALWAYS recommend her! Thank you for everything, Inês.
The best for baths and grooming!

We first contacted Patas & Co for help with the separation anxiety of our 10 years old dog.
Inês was always very helpful and patient and would consider all of our worries and questions, both in sessions and when communicating on WhatsApp (she also has amazing English which was a great help). You can see that she truly loves and understands dogs and that dogs love her back.
We ended up fixing other behaviors (such as snacking on trash outside) and even improving her socializing with other dogs which was amazing!
Definitely recommend it!

If you want someone who will care about your dog as much as you do - look no further. Inês is the most understanding, caring, knowledgeable, attentive and responsible trainer we could ever hope for! She respects both dogs and their owners, shares a lot of knowledge to help you understand your dog’s behavior and guides you all the way through the training supporting you not just when she’s there, but also through constant communication online (also, she speaks great English!). She also finds ways and people to help you with satisfying your dog’s needs - for example, she helped us to find an amazing boarding for our dog when she was not available herself, and gave us some great recommendations from her vet contacts. We ourselves and our dog couldn’t be more grateful for Patas & Co and Inês, highly recommended!

We purchased the package of 8 individual lessons + 2 group lessons and started the classes when Timon was about 8 months old. Mafalda was a very present, helpful, and available trainer. We were always in contact, not only during the classes themselves, but also by phone, message, and sending videos of our exercises outside of class. Timon's growth was noticeable in just 3 months. Today he is a calmer, freer, and more obedient dog. We got to know the rest of the team during the group classes and they were tireless. We recommend them 200%!

Molly has always been a very anxious dog with some episodes of reactivity. We thought it was normal and part of her personality, until we met Mafalda who advised us to do some training sessions. The result was surprising, Molly became much more confident when facing challenges and we learned how to deal with and predict episodes of reactivity. In addition to the training, the boarding service is something that now leaves us super relaxed... The constant feedback and the affection they give Molly makes us feel that she is as well treated as if she were with us.

I have no doubt in recommending the services of Patas & Co.
